evidence.note: יָלְדָה אֶת תּוּבַל קַיִן names Zillah’s son. וַאֲחוֹת תּוּבַל קַיִן נַעֲמָה repeats his full name and identifies Naamah as his sister.

name: תּוּבַל קַיִן
note: The verse establishes the full name but leaves its derivation uncertain.
summary: Zillah bears Tubal-cain, whom Genesis associates with work in bronze and iron and identifies as Naamah’s brother.
